summary: Steep narrow street; only flatter bit is at the junction beside homes.
reasons: Flattest part is at the junction

best_section.where: Top end of Lucinda Street, east kerb, just before the cross street

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 15 m away at 89 m, detached houses 22-24 m on the same side, more houses beyond the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, cars park on the west side; east kerb is tree-lined and tight beside the junction.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, meeting a busier cross street at the north end.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along the west kerb, but the east side is mostly driveways and trees.

flags: Steep: mean 16.1%, max 27.4%; only the last 10 m is under 6%
Best section sits at a junction, likely no room to stop legally
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the east kerb, shade through most of the day.
